content.text: In Nigeria, Kenya, and Zimbabwe, Stripe and PayPal block more creators than they serve. Your digital products—[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-how-sell-ebooks-kenya-works-how-deploy-17|How How]], courses, presets—need infrastructure that no platform can revoke. This guide deploys a crypto-native store on Cloudflare Pages, using Stack 02 [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-13|COREMERCH guide to architecture]]-behind-cloudflare-webhook-driven-crypto-payment-12|architecture]]. You own the code, the data, the revenue stream. No subscriptions. No platform taxes. Built for regions where conventional payment processors are absent or hostile.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Cloudflare Pages provides free global CDN hosting with instant cache invalidation. Cloudflare Workers execute your backend logic at the edge, closer to your buyers. Supabase manages orders in a scalable PostgreSQL database. NOWPayments verifies on-chain crypto payments without buyer accounts. Together, these tools form a stack no single entity controls. Your store operates even if a component fails. This is infrastructure sovereignty—not a workaround. You chose architecture over rentership.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Register a Cloudflare account. Create a NOWPayments merchant profile—no KYC required. Choose BSC, Solana, or TRON for transaction fees under $0.10. Prepare your digital products as ZIP files. Write your product descriptions and pricing in a Google Sheet. You’ll map this sheet to Supabase during deployment. If using a custom domain, have your DNS credentials ready. This stack assumes you’re not starting from zero—you’re building to own.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Deploy a Cloudflare Worker to handle payment webhooks from NOWPayments. Configure the Worker to write order data to Supabase when payment confirms. Set up R2 storage for product files. Use Cloudflare’s API to generate signed URLs for secure file delivery. Test the pipeline with testnet crypto before going live. Each layer is decoupled—if NOWPayments updates their API, your Worker absorbs the change. Your store remains operational.
Your store runs on infrastructure you own—not platforms that can revoke access.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Push your frontend to Cloudflare Pages. Point your Worker’s webhook URL to NOWPayments. Send a test payment from a wallet you control. Verify the product delivery email arrives. Check Supabase for the order record. Once confirmed, promote your store. Use the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) if you need COREMERCH to deploy this for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested. Otherwise, follow the Sovereign Blueprint to deploy manually in 4-6 hours.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

The post-deployment ownership transfer is explicit in every COREMERCH deployment. When the build is complete and the end-to-end test passes, COREMERCH provides the credentials and configuration details for every component under the customer's accounts. The GitHub or Cloudflare repository is under the customer's account from the start. The Supabase or Google Sheets database is under the customer's account. The NOWPayments account is under the customer's email. COREMERCH removes collaborator access upon delivery. From that point, the store runs entirely under the customer's own accounts.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages for hosting and Google Apps Script for backend logic, suitable for deploying in 4-6 hours with up to 3 products. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with 5 products, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end tested. Choose Stack 01 if you’re technical and time-rich. Choose Stack 02 if you need enterprise-grade infrastructure without the deployment risk.
Crypto payments verify on-chain. No buyer accounts required. No chargebacks.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If manual deployment feels risky, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) delivers Stack 02 infrastructure in 48 hours, fully tested. For self-deployment, start with the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) for complete documentation. Explore deployed examples at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. Both paths give you infrastructure no platform can revoke.
Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?
Yes. Purchase the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for COREMERCH to deploy Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested. Alternatively, follow the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) for step-by-step guidance.
What happens if Cloudflare or NOWPayments goes down?
Your store remains operational. Cloudflare’s global CDN ensures high availability. NOWPayments’ webhook system retries failed requests. Your data persists in Supabase. No single point of failure.
How do I handle chargebacks with crypto payments?
Crypto transactions are irreversible. Once payment confirms on-chain, the buyer owns the product. Use NOWPayments’ testnet mode to simulate refunds during testing.
Can I use my own domain with this stack?
Yes. Configure your DNS settings to point to your Cloudflare Pages deployment. If using email delivery, set up SPF/DKIM/DMARC records to ensure deliverability.
What’s the ongoing cost after deployment?

Cloudflare Pages and Workers are free. Supabase’s free tier handles thousands of orders. NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction. Your only recurring cost is the crypto network fee—under $0.10 per transaction on recommended networks.
Deploy once. Scale indefinitely. This is commerce infrastructure, not a workaround.
